Hi Caroline — thanks for the quick reply and for pulling AP in.

Short answers to your questions:
- Redwood is registered for VAT in IE (IE-9876543). For B2B transactions where the buyer is VAT-registered in the EU, the invoice should normally be zero-rated with reverse charge. Please treat INV-3421 under reverse charge; the invoice includes our VAT reference but I’ve pasted it here as well: IE-9876543.
- We don’t typically supply a separate VAT "certificate" — most customers accept our VAT registration confirmation and the buyer’s VAT number for reverse charge treatment. If your tax team requires additional evidence, we can provide a signed confirmation letter from our finance team (please confirm the preferred recipient and format).

For remittance: please include our invoice number (INV-3421) and your internal PO 900221 on the payment reference. If you need to split payment across two remittances, that’s OK — just ask AP to include partial remittance notes so our AR team can match.

I’ve uploaded a short PDF with the VAT registration screenshot to Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-invoice-evidence

If we receive confirmation today, we will mark the invoice as 'pending receipt' and waive any late fee.

Thanks,
